title: Concept: SHA-1 use via hashlib.sha1 (python) — review required
description: In python, hashlib.sha1 computes SHA-1. Public collision demonstrations ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity, though content addressing and legacy interop remain legitimate. The python-specific remedy is hashlib.sha256.
applicability: python codebases hashing data through hashlib.sha1; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged signatures and integrity values where SHA-1 guards trust; LOW default severity, raised when the digest is security-relevant.
